newsitem.title: USA: IVAX sees more charges in balance of 1997.
newsitem.headline: IVAX sees more charges in balance of 1997.

text.p: IVAX Corp said Friday it expects to post additional charges related to consolidation and restructuring efforts in the rest of 1997.
In the second quarter, the company reported a $20.5 million charge related primarily to write-down of assets at its Zenith Goldline facilities as a result of those consolidation efforts.

"The restructuring which commenced in the third quarter of 1996 represented a good start at improving the efficiency of our U.S. generic drug operations," Chairman and Chief Executive Phillip Frost said in a statement.

"After examining those operations in the context of our evolving long-term strategic plan, we are now in the process of implementing further facility consolidations in our U.S. generic drug operations."
Frost added that the second-quarter charge is viewed as an "initial estimate of the minimum level of charges associated with expected losses on facility disposals."
IVAX is a holding company with core subsidiaries engaged primarily in the research, development, manufacture and marketing of generic and branded pharmaceuticals.
